---
name: api-development
description: Design and implement maintainable APIs while preserving contracts, validation, security, error handling, and tests.
---

# API Development Skill

- Inspect existing API conventions first.
- Preserve compatible contracts when possible.
- Validate all external input.
- Apply authentication and authorization consistently.
- Use appropriate HTTP methods and status codes.
- Keep response structures consistent with the project.
- Avoid leaking internal errors or sensitive data.
- Document meaningful contract changes.
- Add tests for success, validation, authorization, and failure paths.
